sloka: स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी ।किमर्थमागता चैव सर्वमाख्यात मा चिरम् ।। ७.८८.१७ ॥
transliteration: sa tāḥ papraccha dharmātmā kasyaiṣā lokasundarī ।kimarthamāgatā caiva sarvamākhyāta mā ciram ।। 7.88.17 ॥

translations.english: The righteous king asked them, "Whose is this most beautiful woman, and for what purpose has she come? Tell me everything without delay."
